run_coco_error_analysis: run the COCO error analysis tool on a detection result JSON file to generate precision-recall error breakdown plots
run_analyze_results: run analyze_results to evaluate COCO detection results against ground truth annotations and save precision-recall plots per category
run_analyze_individual_category: run analyze_individual_category to compute supercategory and all-category precision for a single COCO category using COCOeval
run_makeplot: run makeplot to generate and save precision-recall filled area charts for COCO error analysis by IoU type and class
run_main_cli: run the main CLI entry point with a result JSON path and output directory to analyze COCO bbox or segmentation results
